question: Does backend auto-calculate GST on discounted rent at check-in?

orders_probed.comment: 80% discount. 80% of 6700 = 5360 but stored 5325 = 6700-1375 = room-advance (backend caps at room-advance)
89% discount. 89% of 1920 = 1708 but stored 1620 = 1920-300 = room-advance (backend caps at room-advance)

findings: F1: gst_tax field ABSENT from room_info API response (confirmed by probing both orders and folio data)
F2: Backend formula = room_price - room_discount - advance_payment (no GST) for balance_payment
F3: Backend CAPS room_discount at (room_price - advance_payment) - confirmed by data
F4: Frontend-sent gst_tax at check-in is IGNORED by backend
F5: Frontend-sent balance_payment at check-in is OVERRIDDEN by backend own formula
F6: In-house balance display = backend.balance_payment + charge.sgst + charge.cgst (ORIGINAL booking slab)
F7: When bp=0 (max discount + enough advance), GST is waived (shown as 0 balance) per BUG-493
F8: FrontDesk Beta sends gst_tax=0 always - server handles from reservation charge
F9: reservation.amount_after_tax = booking_charge (room rent, NOT total_with_gst) - confirms form.orderAmount = room rent

impact_on_plans.BUG500_F2_GST_strip: DISPLAY-ONLY fix. Does not affect backend stored data. Correct to fix for staff information.
impact_on_plans.BUG496_E4_gstBase_submit: Sent gst_tax is IGNORED by backend. Low backend impact. Good practice to send correct value.
impact_on_plans.BUG500_F1_effectiveBalanceDue: CRITICAL FINDING: if effectiveBalanceDue includes new GST (e.g. 134 for 88% disc), staff overcollects relative to backend formula. Backend stores negative bp, in-house balance shows wrong value using original chargeGst.
impact_on_plans.recommendation: effectiveBalanceDue for Collect Now cap should use backend-compatible formula: room_price - discount - booking_advance. NOT GST-inclusive formula.
